import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns

# Read the data
df = pd.read_csv('data.csv')

# Create a figure with multiple subplots
fig, axes = plt.subplots(2, 3, figsize=(16, 10))
fig.suptitle('Coffee Shop Sales Analysis', fontsize=16, fontweight='bold')

# 1. Product Distribution
product_counts = df['product'].value_counts()
axes[0, 0].bar(product_counts.index, product_counts.values, color='#8B4513')
axes[0, 0].set_title('Product Distribution', fontweight='bold')
axes[0, 0].set_xlabel('Product')
axes[0, 0].set_ylabel('Count')
axes[0, 0].tick_params(axis='x', rotation=45)

# 2. Total Sales by Product
product_sales = df.groupby('product')['total'].sum().sort_values(ascending=False)
axes[0, 1].barh(product_sales.index, product_sales.values, color='#D2691E')
axes[0, 1].set_title('Total Sales by Product', fontweight='bold')
axes[0, 1].set_xlabel('Total Sales ($)')
axes[0, 1].set_ylabel('Product')

# 3. Payment Method Distribution
payment_counts = df['payment_method'].value_counts()
colors = ['#F4A460', '#CD853F']
axes[0, 2].pie(payment_counts.values, labels=payment_counts.index, autopct='%1.1f%%', 
               colors=colors, startangle=90)
axes[0, 2].set_title('Payment Method Distribution', fontweight='bold')

# 4. Customer Age Group Distribution
age_counts = df['customer_age_group'].value_counts()
axes[1, 0].bar(age_counts.index, age_counts.values, color='#A0522D')
axes[1, 0].set_title('Customer Age Group Distribution', fontweight='bold')
axes[1, 0].set_xlabel('Age Group')
axes[1, 0].set_ylabel('Count')
axes[1, 0].tick_params(axis='x', rotation=45)

# 5. Size Distribution
size_counts = df['size'].value_counts()
size_order = ['Small', 'Medium', 'Large']
size_counts = size_counts.reindex(size_order, fill_value=0)
axes[1, 1].bar(size_counts.index, size_counts.values, color='#6F4E37')
axes[1, 1].set_title('Size Distribution', fontweight='bold')
axes[1, 1].set_xlabel('Size')
axes[1, 1].set_ylabel('Count')

# 6. Takeaway vs Dine-in
takeaway_counts = df['is_takeaway'].value_counts()
labels = ['Takeaway' if x == 1 else 'Dine-in' for x in takeaway_counts.index]
axes[1, 2].pie(takeaway_counts.values, labels=labels, autopct='%1.1f%%',
               colors=['#DEB887', '#BC8F8F'], startangle=90)
axes[1, 2].set_title('Takeaway vs Dine-in', fontweight='bold')

plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('output.png', dpi=300, bbox_inches='tight')
plt.close()
